problem: The native XLS custom validation rule retained its PtgRefN tokens but exposed no formula text because rendering lacked a target-cell origin. Native workbook structure protection also failed to prevent worksheet rename, although insertion/removal already enforced the same protection policy. Native defined-name, validation, protection and Mac property-set scopes needed semantic and preservation coverage.
changes: Render DV formulas after validating their ranges, using the top-left of the first stored range as the documented inert preview origin. Give PtgRefN/PtgAreaN a separate origin so ordinary PtgRef/PtgArea coordinates stay literal. Preserve existing shared-formula behavior, rendering bounds, unresolved-name fallback and raw token bytes.
Reuse the existing protected/shared workbook tab check for changed worksheet renames. Keep exact same-name renames as no-ops; worksheet-content protection alone does not prevent a tab rename.
Add six native tests, two formula-preview unit regressions and one protection integration regression. Update the assertion index and affected feature-matrix notes.

verification_scope.defined_names: excel-interaction-print.xls retains exactly FixtureAmounts at workbook scope, Print_Area and Print_Titles at worksheet 0 scope. Record indices, built-in identity, ordinary-name flags, exact token bytes and rendered references are pinned. Print titles retain the BIFF8 whole-column/whole-row extents through row 65536 and column IV. These are reads and preservation checks, not new native name authoring.
verification_scope.validation_inventory: The native Sheet1 DVAL declares seven rules: whole B2:B5 (1..10), explicit list C2:C5 (Open/Closed/Hold with embedded NUL token separators), date D2:D5 (46023..46387), decimal E2:E5 (0..100), time G2:G4 (0.375..0.75), text length H2:H4 (3..5), and custom I2:I4. All flags, source-order ranges, prompt/error metadata and formulas are asserted. The whole rule has Quantity input and Invalid quantity titles, no prompt body, and its exact saved error text.
verification_scope.relative_formula_fix: The custom native formula now renders as =(MOD(I2,2)=0) with its original 15 token bytes untouched and stored values 2/4/6 unchanged. The first range is a library preview convention; formula execution would use the cell being validated. Unit regressions distinguish ordinary coordinate references from N-token offsets, preserve first-range order despite a later A1 range, cover mixed absolute/relative references and areas, verify BIFF wraparound to IV65536, and retain a valid unresolved PtgNameV when no workbook context exists.
verification_scope.protection: The native workbook has passwordless structure protection, with window/revision/write protection off, zero workbook/revision verifiers and no file-sharing metadata. Its sheet/object/scenario flags are on, with no sheet password. Changed tab rename now returns the typed Protected refusal and leaves publication exact; exact same-name rename remains a no-op. A synthetic workbook verifies that sheet-only protection still allows rename and that the protected sheet and inverse remain intact.
verification_scope.mac_properties: Three native XLS sources retain author/modifier Ryker Zhu, application Microsoft Macintosh Excel, their exact saved creation/modification timestamps, empty company, security 0 and codepage 10000. The interaction/print file retains a 140-byte reserved _PID_HLINKS blob containing the inert fixture URL. The metadata and macro fixtures have no custom-property section. No-op metadata transactions preserve exact source bytes.
verification_scope.metadata_crud: Across interaction/print, metadata and recorded-macro workbooks, create a title and custom Boolean, update the Boolean, then remove the authored values. A mixed unsupported identifier update fails atomically after prior changes. Each commit saves/reopens, forward-replays exactly, rejects stale replay and inverts to the exact source CFB bytes. Workbook bytes, names, validation records, protection flags, VBA/other streams, root CLSID, standard document-summary values and existing custom values remain preserved.
verification_scope.unicode_custom_properties: Adding the Chinese custom property 审核=完成 to the native MacExcel interaction file switches only the custom section to UTF-16. The complete SummaryInformation stream stays byte-identical; standard summary/document-summary snapshots, native reserved hyperlink bytes and other streams remain exact. File reopen and inverse pass.
verification_scope.specification_basis: Read-only research used MS-XLS 2.4.95 Dv, 2.5.198.9 DVParsedFormula, 2.5.198.88 PtgRefN, 2.5.198.31 PtgAreaN, 2.5.198.109 RgceLoc, 2.5.198.111 RgceLocRel and 2.4.207 Protect. The reference structures distinguish literal coordinates from offsets relative to an evaluation cell; the implementation only renders a documented preview. No production/test code references the research checkout.
verification_scope.limits: No validation rule is executed, no cell value is rejected by an Excel-compatible validator, and no formula is recalculated. Native name/validation CRUD is not claimed. Protection assertions qualify workbook tab rename; they do not claim a general worksheet authorization policy for all scalar edits. New title/custom-property values are Litchi-authored derivatives. No hyperlink navigation, macro execution, fresh Excel reopen or native UI validation occurred.
